newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom wins 130 mln Ffr UAE turbine contract.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom wins 130 mln Ffr UAE turbine contract.

text.p: GEC Alsthom said on Tuesday it had won a 130 million franc order to supply two 37 MW gas turbines for the Al Hamriyah power station in the United Arab Emirates.
The power plant will be supplied on a turnkey basis, excluding the civil engineering part, to the Sharjah ministry of electricty and water, the Anglo-French joint venture said.
The gas turbines will be supplied by European Gas Turbines, a unit of GEC Alsthom, and will enter service by September 1997.
GEC Alsthom is a joint venture between General Electric Company Plc (GEC) and Alcatel Alsthom.
